# Hjalp.ai

> > AI-powered product support platform providing user manuals, troubleshooting guides, and maintenance instructions for power tools, home appliances, and garden equipment.

Hjalp.ai offers comprehensive documentation and how-to guides for popular brands including Bosch, Makita, Ryobi, Siemens, AEG, and many others. The platform helps users install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair their tools and appliances through structured guides and safety procedures.

## Key Topics

- Power tools (Bosch, Makita, Ryobi, Metabo, Milwaukee)
- Home appliances (Siemens, AEG, Electrolux, Smeg, Cylinda)
- Garden equipment (AL-KO, Einhell, Pattfield)
- Installation guides
- Troubleshooting procedures
- Product maintenance
- User manuals
- Safety procedures
- Workwear and protective equipment (Helly Hansen, Carhartt, TEGERA, 3M Peltor)
- Aquarium equipment (EHEIM, Fluval, JBL)
- Bathroom fixtures (Hafa, Noro, Oras)
- Heating systems (EUROM, Thermex)
- Emergency shutdown procedures
- Tool care and inspection
- Home improvement projects
